Commentary.Commentary: Whoever will win this game, will go on top, but if Ireland win this and later on, Jersey beat Hong Kong, Jersey can top the table with a superior net run rate! So how many Irish fans are out there?

Mark Adair was brilliant early on, with 4-0-21-0 but the rest were inconsistent. Strangely, Dockrell bowled only 2 overs. The track looks dry and there will be spin on offer. So far, Ireland have all been Stirling in this tournament. If Canada manage to get rid of him early, we could be in for a cliffhanger. Stay tuned!

It did look like 180 could be on the cards and perhaps even 200, when Mark Adair put Dhaliwal down on 68. But he was out immediately and then, Ireland got their chance through the half-open door. Just 32 runs came in the last 5 overs, which is a testimony to their comeback.

157 then, is the target for Ireland. They have done reasonably well to pull things back, but 156 is not a bad score from Canada. The Canadians started poorly but then the Nelson-run stand between Dhaliwal and Nitish Kumar kept the Irish at bay.
BEATEN! Slower delivery outside off, Kirton looks to slog it away but fails to put any bat on it. Brilliant last over from Adair as only six runs have come off it. CANADA FINISH ON 156 FOR 5.
Good length delivery on middle, Heyliger pushes it towards the mid off region and takes a single.
Full delivery on middle, Heyliger flicks it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a couple.
Nicholas Kirton is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Slower delivery on the middle stump line, Heyliger looks to slog it away but misses the ball. They are looking to steal a bye but Wilson has a shy at the stumps and  throws it to Adair at the bowler's end. He hits the stumps and Singh has to go.
Short ball on middle, Heyliger pulls it towards the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Excellent delivery from Adair! Slower yorker down the leg side, Singh moves towards the leg side and looks to slog it away but misses the ball completely. The steal a bye.
Fullish delivery around off, Singh moves towards the off side and lofts it towards the deep mid-wicket region and takes a single. Good over for the Irish.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They manage to come back for the second.
Full delivery outside off, Singh plays this uppishly towards the extra cover region and takes a couple.
Full toss on middle, Heyliger plays it towards long on and takes a single.
On a length outside off, Singh cuts it hard towards the cover region and takes another single.
Good length ball outside off, Heyliger punches this off the back foot towards the cover region.
David Delany is back into the attack. His figures 3-0-23-1.
Length and on off, Heyliger drives it to long off for a single.
Short one on middle, Singh pulls it to mid-wicket once again for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Singh pulls it to mid-wicket for another couple.
Length and on off, Singh flicks it to the longest part of the ground at mid-wicket. A couple taken easily.
Good slower ball! Adair bowls a slower one outside off, Singh looks to run that down towards third man but fails to lay bat on ball.
Length ball on off, Heyliger defends it to the off side  and takes a quick single.
Mark Adair comes back on.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball outside off, Singh cuts it towards the point region and takes a single to get off the mark.
Dillon Heyliger is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tariq goes for a golden duck here! Slower delivery outside off, Tariq looks to loft this over the extra cover fielder but the ball hits the splice of the bat. Kevin O'Brien runs in from extra cover and takes a simple running catch. That is 3 wickets in the span of 10 balls!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Hamza Tariq is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Oh no... I should not have said that. I should not have said that! I have jinxed Kumar here. So so so sorry, Nitish! A ball ago, I had mentioned Kumar needs to continue. But he perishes as soon as he reaches fifty! End of another excellent innings though. Full delivery on the leg stump line, Nitish makes room towards the leg side and flicks it uppishly. But the ball goes straight into the hands of Tector at deep mid-wicket. So the century stand is broken first and then both set batsmen depart in the span of 8 balls. Ireland are making a strong comeback here.

EDGED AND FOUR! Fifty for Kumar! Full delivery outside off, Kumar looks to drive it but it goes off the outside edge and past the diving keeper and into the third man fence. Third consecutive fifty for Kumar in this tournament. Needs to continue here.
Boyd Rankin comes on to bowl his final over of the innings.
Short delivery on middle, Singh pulls it towards the leg side and takes a couple. The fielder from deep mid-wicket comes around and cleans it up.
Yorker length on middle, Singh digs it out towards the bowler.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kumar flicks it towards square leg for a single.

Floated ball on middle, Ravinderpal looks to defend but it goes off the inside half of his bat towards fine leg and takes a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The batsman would have been in though.
Ravinderpal Singh is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time the catch has been taken! Flatter delivery on off, Dhaliwal rocks on his front foot and pulls it but it goes straight into the hands of Harry Tector at deep mid-wicket who makes no mistake. End of an excellent innings from Dhaliwal.
Gareth Delany is back into the attack.
SIX! Adding insult to injury is Kumar! Thompson bowls a full toss on middle, Kumar picks it and hammers it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.

DROPPED! A big chance goes abegging. Ireland cannot afford this! Slower delivery outside off, Kumar looks to play the helicopter shot but it goes straight to Mark Adair at long on who makes a mess of this simple catch. Probably the sun was shining directly into his eyes, that's why he missed it.
Low full toss outside off, Nitish drives this through mid off and takes a single.
Slower delivery on the off stump line, Dhaliwal swats this towards deep mid-wicket and crosses over for another single.
Full delivery outside off, Kumar drives it nicely towards the mid off region and takes a single.
Short ball on the middle stump line, Dhaliwal camps on his back foot and lofts this towards long on for a single. Mark Adair at long on cleans it up.
Stuart Thompson is back into the attack. He has bowled just one over so far.
FOUR! Innovative from Kumar. Dockrell bowls one on off, Kumar reverse sweeps it up and over the point fielder. The ball races to the  boundary.
MISFIELD! Kumar flicks this tossed up ball to mid-wicket where the fielder misfields to allow the ball to go through. The batsmen take a couple till the ball is fielded in the deep.
Tossed up on off, driven through covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, pulled  to the mid-wicket region for a couple.

SIX! Thrashed! Poor ball this from Rankin though. Short delivery on the middle stump line, Navneet rocks back and pulls it with disdain towards the deep mid-wicket region for a huge maximum.
Full delivery on middle, Kumar flicks it towards the leg side and takes another single.

Flighted delivery on off, Kumar looks to reverse sweep this one but gets an edge towards point but it just falls short of the fielder.
Floated ball outside off, Navneet comes down the track and lofts this towards the long off region for a single.

EDGED AND FOUR! Lucky for Kumar here. Looks to pull this flatter delivery but it goes off the bottom edge and it misses the keeper. It goes into the fine leg fence for a boundary.

FIFTY! Third one in T20Is for Dhaliwal. It has been an excellent innings from him so far. Good length delivery on middle, Dhaliwal works it towards the leg side and takes a couple to reach the landmark.
On a length outside off, Navneet pushes it towards the point region for nothing.

SIX! Brilliant, just brilliant from Dhaliwal! Full delivery outside off, Dhaliwal lunges forward and lofts this over the long on fielder for another maximum. He moves on to 49 with that. Canada are looking very dangerous here.
Good length delivery on middle, Kumar works it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single.

BEATEN! Gareth bowls this with a lot of air outside off, Kumar looks to drive it but fails to put any bat on it.

FOUR! Nicely played! Gareth bowls a rank long-hop on off, Dhaliwal rocks back on his back foot and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. The fielder tries chasing it but is unable to do so.

FOUR! Brilliantly played from Kumar! He is in terrific form at the moment. Delany bowls a flighted delivery on middle, Nitish plays a lovely inside out shot towards the cover region for a boundary.

Floated ball outside off, Dhaliwal sweeps it from off towards the square leg region for a couple. Rankin runs in and makes an excellent stop.

We are all set to begin! The Canadian openers, Rizwan Cheema and Navneet Dhaliwal make their way out to the middle. The Irish players are also making their way out to the middle. Mark Adair will start for the Irish. Rizwan Cheema is on strike.

Canada (PLAYING XI) - Rizwan Cheema (IN FOR RODRIGO THOMAS), Navneet Dhaliwal(C), Nitish Kumar, Nicholas Kirton, Ravinderpal Singh, Saad Bin Zafar, Hamza Tariq(WK), Dillon Heyliger, Nikhil Dutta, Romesh Eranga (IN FOR ABRAASH KHAN), Jeremy Gordon.

Ireland (PLAYING XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O Brien, Gareth Delany, Harry Tector, Gary Wilson(WK/C), Mark Adair, Andrew Balbirnie (IN FOR LORCAN TUCKER), David Delany, George Dockrell, Boyd Rankin, Stuart Thompson.
Toss - Canada has won the toss. They have to bat first.

Welcome to our coverage of the 25th match of the ICC World T20 Qualifiers between Ireland and Canada. The Irish are coming off a big win against Oman in their previous game. Gareth Delaney is in good form with both bat and ball. Ireland would hope for a performance which would take them closer to the top of group B. Canada, on the other hand, are roaring with two back-to-back wins. Nitish Kumar has been the star for them with twin fifties. The Canadians would want to regain the top spot with a match-winning performance against the strong Irish team. Toss and team updates in a while.
